findings.label: Loose email image fetch error handling
findings.description: If a product image fetch fails during email send, the email is still sent without that image's CID inline. This is intentional (non-blocking design) but could create asymmetry between customer and admin emails if some images fail in transit. The code logs failures and continues, which is resilient. Verify in production that missing images don't confuse recipients.

findings.label: Email credentials placeholder in production
findings.description: GMAIL_PASSWORD is set to [placeholder - needs update]. All emails will fail silently in production until the real password is configured. Email service guards check for missing credentials and return 500 during requests, but the checkout page doesn't surface this error to the user — order placement succeeds but email never sends. Consider adding a warning toast or health check before shipping.
